by.claim: rfc-003-cybersecurity-advisor.md's design decision to add a Senior Cybersecurity Advisor position in the Front Office — whose hours are explicitly 'not work assigned to a single engagement' and whose funding source the RFC says 'should be identified' rather than already secured — creates new headcount cost that lands in exactly the expense line policies/finance-and-billing.md flags as unmanageable: 'Overhead from TTS and GSA... is allocated and not under our control.' The RFC's own funding caveat is the unacknowledged symptom of adding non-billable capacity into a budget lever the finance document says TTS cannot directly adjust.
